_comment: Phase KN (docs/AI_JOB_KNOBS_SPEC.md in mchatai_macOS). An AI JOB is a recurring thing mChatAI+ asks a model to do for the user. Each gets ONE card of knobs (AIJobCardView): Best Quality | Lowest Cost, or an engine the user picks, with readiness, speed measured on this Mac, and the ratings below. Which engine runs is AIJobEngineResolver's decision; running it is AIJobRunner's.

engineProfiles._comment: Ratings for engines the Ollama catalog (harness/ollama-catalog.json) does not cover. Same scale as its taskScores: 0.95 best in class, 0.75 solidly capable, 0.55 workable fallback, 0.30 avoid. Keys are 'foundation' or an AppletProvider raw value.

foundation.detail: Apple's on-device model, built into macOS
foundation._taskScoresNote: 2026-09-29, mail.summary on a real message: the quoted asks were right; the gist was a sentence copied from the email. Hence analysis below a workable fallback.

mChatAI Cloud.detail: mChatAI's hosted models, paid in compute tokens
mChatAI Cloud._taskScoresNote: A hosted ladder; the model behind it varies. Rated as a strong general model.

jobs.title: Email summaries for assistants
jobs.blurb: The gist and the sender's questions, for the few emails an assistant asks about. The assistant gets the summary, never the email.
jobs._privacy: Lawrence, 2026-09-29: keep email on this Mac. Cloud engines are listed, locked, with lockedReason. AIJobRunner also refuses a cloud rung for a local job whatever a row says, and MailSafeSummary passes its own local-only allowlist.
jobs._defaultMode: Safe on an 8-16 GB Mac. The card recommends Best Quality wherever a better-rated local model is installed.
jobs._reasoning: A one-line summary needs no long reasoning. A model that thinks is sent think:false (or 'low' where the catalog says it takes levels); measured, qwen3.5 went from 195 s and an empty answer to 10 s and a good one.

jobs.title: AI Inbox Summarise button
jobs.blurb: Summarises the thread you are reading and quotes what is asked of you, when you press Summarise.
jobs._defaultEngine: What the button always used before it had a card (MailTriageService, to 2026-09-29). It stays the starting choice so adding the card changed nothing (RULE #4); one click on the card keeps email on this Mac instead.

jobs.title: Learn my writing voice
jobs.blurb: Keeps a short guide to how you write email up to date, from the drafts you edit and the email you send. Assistants follow it when they write for you.
jobs._privacy: The evidence is the person's own writing: drafts they edited and email they sent, quoted and forwarded text removed. Best Quality by default: Apple's on-device model returned repeated, rule-shaped content claims (2026-09-30), and the app refuses a reply that drops the guide's first line, repeats a rule, or loses half the current rules. Lowest Cost on the card keeps it on this Mac.
